description: Create an outgoing invoice as a draft (status 50) — always a draft, so nothing reaches a customer without review in sevDesk. Positions carry name, quantity, price and tax rate; the contact's address is filled in automatically. Honors SEVDESK_DRY_RUN. ⚠️ This tool can change data in sevDesk.

contactId.description: Numeric id of the customer contact.

dryRun.description: Preview the request without sending it.

taxRate.description: VAT rate; defaults to what the tax rule allows (19 for rule 1, 0 for 0%-only rules). Required for OSS rules.

taxRuleId.description: Revenue tax rule id — required, never guessed. 1 taxable domestic, 2 export, 3 intra-EU supply, 4 §4 exempt, 5 §13b, 11 §19 UStG (no VAT shown), 17 not taxable domestically, 18-20 One Stop Shop (per-position taxRate required), 21 §18b.

name: sevdesk_create_invoice
title: Create a draft invoice
